propositions: Tests in test_build_provenance.py rebuild identical clean-source wheel and sdist artifacts three times per test run (35.93s baseline), violating DRY and OSS consensus patterns from Setuptools and PyPA Build.

Wheel-from-sdist, sdist-content, and install-from-sdist tests can share one immutable session-scoped prerequisite wheel/sdist pair while install-from-sdist and empty-env retain their distinct real builds in function-scoped contexts.

A session-scoped fixture per xdist worker must return only read-only artifact paths; consumers extract locally or rebuild independently, preventing shared state mutation and preserving all archive-content and provenance assertions.

Deterministic build-call counter oracle must enforce exactly one successful REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234 prerequisite build per worker/session; defect seeding (duplicate build or corrupted COMMIT) must return RED to validate the oracle and fixture correctness.
